title: Diastereodivergence in catalytic asymmetric conjugate addition of carbon nucleophiles
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,715-741
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00485J, Review Article
Byungjun Kim, Hooseung Lee, Ilwoo Song, Sarah Yunmi Lee
This review explores various catalytic strategies for achieving diverse diastereomeric outcomes in asymmetric conjugate additions creating carbon–carbon bonds.
